ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This course section is restricted to undergraduate non-degree students only. Enrolled students are required to have a working microphone and speakers, or a headset with a microphone and speakers, and a high speed internet connection.
